disclaimer: Research/demo benchmark only; not clinical accuracy or medical performance.
selection_method: deterministic greedy diversity selection: target anchors (12), high multilabel (2), low label count (1), structural outliers (2), farthest-point label+structure diversity (5); ties broken by study ID; see benchmarks/amd/README.md

scenarios.title: Effusion-focused / isolated finding
scenarios.why_selected: Coverage anchor for Effusion: the most focused unselected study positive for it (1 positive target).
scenarios.expected_demo_behavior: Resolve the study by study_id, show the deterministic quality status and the 12 model probabilities side by side; the competition reference labels are positive for Effusion. Probabilities are research outputs, not a diagnosis; a reviewer decision is required.
